name: @kinti/a11y-toolkit
description: Zero-dependency WCAG 2.2 accessibility engine (34 MCP tools + CLI): audits, contrast fixing, SHA-256-sealed evidence packs, SARIF, EARL/ACT, CI ratchet. Self-contained: the pure-stdlib Python engine ships inside and runs via python3 — no downloads, no installs.
author: Jesús Quintana
